sources.description: Git repository for the call-the-match project
Testing PRD with all required test categories

tasks.title: MVC Controller Tests – AccountController
tasks.description: Create src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/controller/AccountControllerTests.java using @SpringBootTest + @AutoConfigureMockMvc. Test GET /register (status 200, view account/register, model has inputRegistrationDto), GET /login (status 200, view account/login), POST /register with valid data (redirect to login or success route), POST /register with invalid data (returns view account/register with field errors on firstName, lastName, userName, email, password), and POST /register without CSRF token (403). Use .with(csrf()) for POST requests and SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors where needed.
acceptance_criteria: GET /register returns status 200 with view name account/register and model attribute inputRegistrationDto
GET /login returns status 200 with view name account/login
POST /register with valid params redirects to login or success page
POST /register with blank/invalid params returns view account/register with field errors on firstName, lastName, userName, email, password
POST /register without CSRF token returns 403
Test class is in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/controller/ package

tasks.title: MVC Controller Tests – CompetitionController
tasks.description: Create src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/controller/CompetitionControllerTests.java using @SpringBootTest + @AutoConfigureMockMvc. Test GET /competition (status 200, view competition/list, model has competitionList), GET /competition/1 (status 200, view competition/show, model has competition), GET /competition/999999 (status 404, view error/404), GET /competition/add as ADMIN (status 200, view competition/add, model has stadiums, countries, inputCompetitionDto), POST /competition/add as ADMIN with valid data (redirect to /home), POST /competition/add as ADMIN with invalid data (returns view competition/add with error), GET /competition/add as USER (403). Use .with(user(...).roles(...)) and .with(csrf()).
acceptance_criteria: GET /competition returns status 200 with view competition/list and model attribute competitionList
GET /competition/1 returns status 200 with view competition/show and model attribute competition
GET /competition/999999 returns status 404 with view error/404
GET /competition/add as ADMIN returns status 200 with view competition/add and model attributes stadiums, countries, inputCompetitionDto
POST /competition/add as ADMIN with valid data redirects to /home
POST /competition/add as ADMIN with invalid data returns view competition/add
GET /competition/add as USER returns 403
Test class is in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/controller/ package

tasks.title: MVC Controller Tests – HomeController
tasks.description: Create src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/controller/HomeControllerTests.java using @SpringBootTest + @AutoConfigureMockMvc. Test GET /home returns status 200, view home, model contains competitionList. Verify this route is accessible without authentication (guest access).
acceptance_criteria: GET /home returns status 200 with view name home and model attribute competitionList
GET /home is accessible without authentication
Test class is in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/controller/ package

tasks.title: MVC Controller Tests – RankingController

teamList contains at most 10 entries sorted by score descending

tasks.title: MVC Controller Tests – TeamController
tasks.description: Create src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/controller/TeamControllerTests.java using @SpringBootTest + @AutoConfigureMockMvc. Test: GET /team/dashboard as USER (status 200, view team/dashboard, model has teamList, inputTeamDto, inputTeamJoinDto, shows only current user's teams). POST /team/create as USER with valid name (redirect /team/dashboard). POST /team/create with blank name (returns view team/dashboard with field error on name). POST /team/create with duplicate name (returns view with error on name). POST /team/join with valid invite-code (redirect). POST /team/join with invalid code (returns dashboard with field error on inviteCode). GET /team/{id} as member (status 200, view team/show, model has team and isOwner). GET /team/{id} as non-member (403). POST /team/{id}/invite-code as non-owner (403). POST /team/{id}/members/{memberId}/remove as non-owner (403). Use .with(user(...).roles('USER')) and .with(csrf()).
acceptance_criteria: GET /team/dashboard as USER returns status 200 with view team/dashboard and model attributes teamList, inputTeamDto, inputTeamJoinDto
Dashboard teamList contains only teams owned by or joined by the authenticated user
POST /team/create with valid name redirects to /team/dashboard
POST /team/create with blank name returns view team/dashboard with field error on name
POST /team/create with duplicate name returns view team/dashboard with error on name
POST /team/join with valid invite-code redirects to /team/dashboard
POST /team/join with invalid invite-code returns view team/dashboard with field error on inviteCode
GET /team/{id} as member returns status 200 with view team/show and model attributes team, isOwner
GET /team/{id} as non-member returns 403
POST /team/{id}/invite-code as non-owner returns 403
POST /team/{id}/members/{memberId}/remove as non-owner returns 403
Test class is in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/controller/ package

tasks.title: Security Tests – Role-Based Access
tasks.description: Create src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/security/AccessSecurityTests.java using @SpringBootTest + @AutoConfigureMockMvc. Verify all route access decisions per role. Guest can open /home, /ranking, /competition/{id}, /login, /register. Guest is redirected to /login for /team/dashboard and /predictions. USER can open /team/dashboard and /predictions but gets 403 on /competition/add, /competition/edit/{id}, /competition/{id}/result. ADMIN can open /competition/add and /competition/edit/{id} but gets 403 on /team/dashboard and /predictions. Test form-login with correct credentials (email + password) authenticates. Test form-login with wrong credentials redirects to /login?error. Test logout redirects to /login?logout. Test POST endpoints without CSRF return 403.
acceptance_criteria: Guest can access /home, /ranking, /competition/{id}, /login, /register with status 200
Guest accessing /team/dashboard is redirected to /login
Guest accessing /predictions is redirected to /login
USER can access /team/dashboard with status 200
USER accessing /competition/add gets 403
ADMIN can access /competition/add with status 200
ADMIN accessing /team/dashboard gets 403
ADMIN accessing /predictions gets 403
Form-login with correct email and password results in authenticated session
Form-login with incorrect credentials redirects to /login?error
Logout redirects to /login?logout
POST to /team/create without CSRF token returns 403
Test class is in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/security/ package

tasks.title: Validation Tests – Existing Jakarta Annotations
tasks.description: Create validation test classes in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/validation/ for all request DTOs. Use jakarta.validation.Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory().getValidator() without Spring context. Create: InputRegistrationDTOValidationTests (test blank fields, invalid email, short password produce violations; valid input produces none), InputTeamDTOValidationTests (blank name produces violation; valid name produces none), InputTeamJoinDTOValidationTests (blank inviteCode produces violation; valid code produces none), InputCompetitionDTOValidationTests (invalid fields produce violations; valid input produces none). Each test must verify both positive (valid input = no violations) and negative (invalid input = expected violations) cases.
acceptance_criteria: InputRegistrationDTOValidationTests: blank/invalid fields produce violations on firstName, lastName, userName, email, password
InputRegistrationDTOValidationTests: valid input produces zero violations
InputTeamDTOValidationTests: blank name produces violation; valid name produces zero violations
InputTeamJoinDTOValidationTests: blank inviteCode produces violation; valid code produces zero violations
InputCompetitionDTOValidationTests: invalid fields produce violations; valid input produces zero violations
All tests use jakarta.validation.Validator without Spring context
Test classes are in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/validation/ package

tasks.title: Validation Tests – Custom Annotation & Validator Class
tasks.description: Create test class(es) in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/validation/ for custom annotation validator(s). Directly instantiate the ConstraintValidator implementation class (e.g. ValidMatchDateValidator or UniqueTeamNameValidator). Call initialize() if needed. Call isValid(value, context) with a Mockito-mocked ConstraintValidatorContext. Verify: isValid with a valid value returns true, isValid with an invalid value returns false, isValid with null returns true (null-safe convention). At least one custom annotation + validator class must be fully tested.
acceptance_criteria: Validator class is instantiated directly without Spring context
isValid(validValue, mockContext) returns true
isValid(invalidValue, mockContext) returns false
isValid(null, mockContext) returns true (null-safe convention)
ConstraintValidatorContext is mocked with Mockito
At least 1 custom annotation validator is fully tested
Test class is in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/validation/ package

tasks.title: REST Controller Tests
tasks.description: Create test class(es) in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/restcontroller/ for REST endpoints once they exist. Use @SpringBootTest + @AutoConfigureMockMvc with MockMvc. Test: GET on public REST endpoint returns 200 with JSON body, GET on non-existing resource returns 404, POST/PUT/DELETE without authentication returns 401 or 403, POST with valid JSON as authorized user returns 201 or 200, POST with invalid JSON returns 400 with validation errors. Verify JSON structure with jsonPath assertions.
acceptance_criteria: GET on public REST endpoint returns 200 with JSON body verified by jsonPath
GET on non-existing resource returns 404
POST/PUT/DELETE without authentication returns 401 or 403
POST with valid JSON body as authorized user returns 201 or 200
POST with invalid JSON body returns 400 with validation error details
JSON response structure is verified with jsonPath assertions
Test class is in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/restcontroller/ package
